text:
maria: dropping a quick thread for the sync  idea: a compact 'blackout ribbon' in the alert preview that compresses suppression info into one horizontal bar. mock: https://img.redwood.internal/ux/blackout-ribbon.png :sparkles:

anil: a11y callout: ribbon must be linear for SRs; use role=list/listitem and aria-posinset/aria-setsize. Announce on focus: "Blackout ribbon, 3 items. Use left/right to navigate." Also avoid color-only cues.

lisa: copy: call it "Blackout windows" in headings, helper: "Temporarily stop notifications for selected channels." Button: "Edit blackout".

devin: perf: render grouped segments by medium, not per-channel. Backend can return groupedCounts to avoid N+1.
jake: keyboard pattern: roving tabindex, left/right to move, enter edits. Use polite live region for adds/removals.
tara: mobile: show a small chip "2 channels quiet" that expands to full ribbon in a sheet. No hover-only reveals.

kevin: UX nit: badge auto-snoozes with an icon and tooltip: "Auto (policy)" so users understand origin.
maria: action items: maria -> updated mocks, anil -> a11y micro-spec, lisa -> final copy, devin -> grouped payload, jake -> keyboard doc. I'll upload art before EOD.
